title: Authorization and Access Control
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Authorization and Access Control.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Authorization and Access Control topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.

notes: Preserves 8 main lesson(s) from the source PDF. Enforce server-side authorization for every resource operation using the authenticated principal and the resource’s verified ownership or policy; hiding a button is not an access control. Use authorized local labs and synthetic data only.
